feeds.title: Mama Knows Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: If you're looking for help with feeding your young kids - you're in the right place.Kacie Barnes, MCN, RDN, LD is a Registered Dietitian Nutritionist, mom of two, and toddler feeding expert.

feeds.title: Kids Eat in Color Blog
feeds.description: Founded by a pediatric dietitian, Jennifer, Kids Eat in Color is a team of experts that helps parents end food battles and teach their kids to try new foods. From strategies to reverse picky eating to meal tips, we are here to help families reduce mealtime stress and eat happier.

feeds.title: Crystal Karges Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: I'm Crystal Karges, Registered Dietitian Nutritionist and mama of five specializing in intuitive eating for mothers & families. I'm passionately committed to helping you and your children enjoy freedom with food as a family.

feeds.title: Plant Based Juniors Blog
feeds.description: We're Whitney and Alex, moms, dietitians and founders of the Plant-Based Juniors community and we are so glad you're here. PBJs is your complete guide to plant-based prenatal and pediatric nutrition.

feeds.title: Sarah Remmer
feeds.description: My name is Sarah Remmer, and I'm a registered dietitian and mom of 3, and the proud founder and President of The Centre for Family Nutrition, a nutrition counseling practice that specializes in prenatal, infant, and child nutrition. On my blog, I share helpful, reliable nutrition education for busy parents.

feeds.title: SuperKids Nutrition
feeds.description: SuperKids Nutrition, Inc. was founded in August 2006 to save the world one healthy food at a time. We work with registered dietitians & nutrition scientists to provide nutrition education & healthy eating tips to help create future healthier generations through good nutrition.

feeds.title: Autism Dietitian Blog
feeds.description: Find resources for parents of kiddos with ASD along with Solutions for picky eating & gut issues. I'm Brittyn - a Registered Dietitian, Autism Nutrition Expert, and the Creator of the Autism Nutrition Library. I work with parents of children with autism to expand accepted foods for picky eaters and improve gut health by looking deep to find the root causes of their symptoms, and ultimately help them feel their best so that they can thrive.

feeds.title: Dr. Natalie Muth Blog
feeds.description: Find the tools, resources, and information parents, pediatricians, and communities need to raise a generation of healthier eaters and fit, active kids. By Dr. Natalie Muth - a Carlsbad Pediatrician & Nutritionist.

feeds.title: The Children's Nutritionist's Blog
feeds.description: Fortnightly blogs written by Sarah & her team of professionals, with expert advice and inspirational ideas for feeding your little ones. Sarah is a UK Registered Dietitian specialising in babies, toddlers, and children.

feeds.title: Nutrition in Bloom Blog
feeds.description: Make mealtime more peaceful, learn the best ways to introduce solids to your new baby, and easy, nutritious recipes even your picky toddler will love! Evidence-based information and advice on weaning your baby, feeding your toddler and nutrition for children, updated weekly on my childrens' nutrition blog. Rachel Rothman Bloom is a childhood nutrition expert. She offers nutrition counseling, coaching and much more.

feeds.title: Happy Bellies Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: A collection of articles written by dietitians and student dietitians. Our topics include pediatric nutrition, digestive health, intuitive eating, and pregnancy nutrition! We provide evidence-based, holistic and compassionate care for infants, children, teens and adults experiencing digestive distress - turning angry bellies into happy ones!

feeds.title: Bahee Van de Bor Blog
feeds.description: Looking for children's nutrition articles written by a UK paediatric dietitian and nutritionist? Find advice and tips on fussy eating, dairy-free recipes for kids, vegan nutrition, and IBS kids.

feeds.title: Picky Eating Dietitian Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about nutrition for picky eaters by reading the Picky Eating Dietitian blog. Danielle Zold, RD, CLC and author of the blog, is a Pediatric Registered Dietitian and Certified Lactation Counselor.

feeds.title: The Nourished Child Blog
feeds.description: Get the big picture on raising good eaters including nutrition facts for kids, the latest research and easy tips you can use today. The Nourished Child® is a nutrition school providing online nutrition courses and education for parents and kids. Founded by pediatric dietitian, Jill Castle MS, RDN, The Nourished Child® was developed through her 30+ years as a pediatric dietitian.

feeds.title: ARFID Dietitian Blog
feeds.description: Find Dietitian nutritionist approved easy kid and family friendly recipes. Along with tips and resources for feeding families! Hi there, I am Lauren Sharifi! Pediatric and Family Registered Dietitian Nutritionist and mom of three.

feeds.title: Jill Castle Blog
feeds.description: I'm Jill Castle. I'm a pediatric dietitian, author, speaker, and advisor with a deep history of educating parents about childhood nutrition. My clients gain my in-depth knowledge, experience and insight as a nutrition entrepreneur and experienced health professional.

feeds.title: Weaning.ie Blog
feeds.description: Nutrition, News, and tips about feeding babies, children, and families. I'm Cathy, a Mum of 3 with over 15 years of experience in CHI @ Temple Street. As a Senior Paediatric Dietitian, I know how valuable it is to introduce families to the nurturing foundations of food before any problems begin.
